LanguageData.LP_CloudGiantCore.label: cloud giant origin
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiantCore.description: The cloud-born bloodline of the cloud giants, inherited with the race. Adults are 2.2 times the size of an ordinary person (drawn 1.45×, children grow with age); the bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (giant-body rules) and the bigger the appetite (adult stomach ×220%); long strides, but not fast. Cloud giants walk as if on clouds: marsh, mud, shallow water and snow don't slow them, and they never set off traps. They are naturally talkative (Social +3), more cold-tolerant than others (min comfortable temperature -10°C), and don't care about being naked.
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiantCore.customEffectDescriptio: Giant lineage: cloud giant (rank 2 of the ordning).
Body size grows with age, reaching ×2.2 as an adult (drawn ×1.45).
Giant-body rules: health and melee increase with body size (adjustable in mod settings).
Giant stomach: max food rises with body size, ×220% as an adult.
Cloud step: movement cost on marsh, mud, shallow water and snow counts as normal ground (doesn't affect pathfinding detour decisions).
No negative mood from nudity; can wear ordinary clothes; each piece of giant-only apparel gives mood +2 (up to +6).
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiantCore.modExtensions.0.label: cloud giant
LanguageData.LP_CloudNoble.label: noble heart
LanguageData.LP_CloudNoble.description: Cloud giants are born nobles. When their own bedroom's impressiveness is below "very impressive" (or they have no bedroom of their own), mood -4 "beneath my station"; at "extremely impressive", mood +4. They are particular in business too: trade prices +10%.
LanguageData.LP_CloudNoble.customEffectDescriptions.0: Bedroom impressiveness < "very impressive": mood -4; ≥ "extremely impressive": mood +4.
LanguageData.LP_CloudGift.label: wind of gifts
LanguageData.LP_CloudGift.description: Cloud giants make friends with gifts. Select this cloud giant and right-click a visitor or caravan member of another faction to "Give gift": hand over one item from the pack or the ground within 4 cells; that faction's goodwill + (market value ÷ 100 × 1.5, up to +25), and the recipient gets mood +5 for 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_CloudGift.customEffectDescriptions.0: Right-click visitors and caravan members of non-player factions: give a gift (goodwill + market value ÷ 100 × 1.5, up to +25).
LanguageData.LP_CloudGrace.label: gracious
LanguageData.LP_CloudGrace.description: A cloud giant's speech is impeccable: another Social +2, negotiation ability +15%, recruitment talks lower prisoner resistance 15% more.
LanguageData.LP_SkinCloud.label: pale blue-white skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinCloud.description: The pale blue-white skin of a cloud giant, like thin clouds on a clear day.
LanguageData.LP_CloudCrown.label: cloud circlet
LanguageData.LP_CloudCrown.description: A cloud giant's silver circlet chased with curling cloud patterns and set with a piece of sky amber.
